title: Exact admission-family offline performance readiness
purpose: Satisfy REQ-QUIC-CRT-0247 through REQ-QUIC-CRT-0252 with additive factor-space reconciliation, one exact performance-only A0-A7 authorization, deterministic campaign compilation, and a hard boundary before host-sensitive measurement.
design_summary: The retained v2 cell space remains immutable. A v3 document rebinds the same twelve-cell configured admission space to family catalog v5, identifies A0 through A7 as the reviewed exact exhaustive subset, and keeps the four bounded cells blocked. A new internal fixed-field performance token is parallel to, but mutually exclusive with, correctness authorization; it binds one exact campaign manifest and one A0-A7 tuple and carries no performance-acceptance or active authority. A deterministic compiler validates current hashes, expands only the explicit eight cells, freezes workload and counterbalanced execution metadata, and emits a dry-run manifest without running a clock. Actual loopback or rack-lab execution remains a later step because machine identity, workload scope, and evidence destination materially affect the result.
data_and_state_considerations: Canonical control documents are additive, versioned, and content-hashed. Runtime authorization is immutable, internal-only, and connection-local. Compilation reads canonical inputs and emits one deterministic manifest; it does not mutate runtime policy or collect timing data. Later raw runs must be append-only external evidence bound to source, binary, host, manifest, cell, workload, repetition, and checksums.
edge_cases_and_constraints: The eight reviewed cells are exhaustive, so covering arrays would reduce evidence without reducing a large search space.
The four bounded_multi_fragment cells remain present but blocked on shadow_recommendation_value_mismatch.
Oversized fragments can prevent batch and buffer distinctness on the same operation; separate run-local operations preserve attribution.
The older send_composition performance authorization and every correctness authorization are mutually exclusive with this token.
A clean local dry run does not establish a stable performance result.
alternatives_considered: Modify factor-cell-space v2 in place; rejected because retained canonical versions are immutable.
Generalize the old two-axis token; rejected because family, proof, and cell boundaries must remain exact.
Implement a covering-array generator now; rejected because eight effective reviewed cells are below the trigger of 65.
Run local timings immediately; rejected because the execution host and workload scope are part of the measurement contract.
risks: A stale catalog binding could authorize the wrong proof set unless all hashes are exact.
A generic multi-axis escape hatch could unintentionally admit blocked cells.
Developer-machine timings could be overinterpreted if host selection is not explicit.
Operation-local noncoactivation could be misclassified as whole-cell inactivity without separate evidence identities.
open_questions: Should the first measured campaign run on the ProtocolLab rack or be explicitly labeled as local developer-host characterization?
Should the first execution be a pilot-only workload subset or the full predeclared train and holdout schedule?
